description.value: University-operated suite-style accommodation on the UBC campus, surrounded by forests and ocean views on Vancouver's west side. Suites come with full kitchens and the property is pursuing LEED Gold certification with carbon-neutral building operations powered by biomass and hydro electricity. A major bus exchange on campus connects to downtown Vancouver in about 25 minutes.

address.value: 5959 Student Union Blvd, Vancouver, BC V6T 1K2

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 29m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Gage Suites is operated by UBC Conferences and Accommodation as year-round guest accommodation with suite-style rooms. Laundry facilities and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi are explicitly stated on the Gage Suites page. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, or any cycling amenities anywhere on the site. OSM names this 'Gage Apartments' but the website consistently uses 'Gage Suites' — flagged as a concern.
